description: US Letter portrait print template wrapper for M.19 invoice, payout statement, and refund receipt PDFs.

documentTitle.description: Title of the document rendered in the header and used in ARIA label

tenantLegalName.description: Legal business name displayed in the footer

merchantId.description: Merchant identifier displayed in the footer center

children.description: Content rendered between the header and footer zones

pageNumber.description: Current page number for the footer pagination string

totalPages.description: Total page count for the footer pagination string

anatomy: header-zone (88px: logo-slot left 120x40 + docTitle heading-2 right)
footer-zone (40px: hairline-rule above + tenantLegalName body-small left + 'Page n of m' body-small right)
